negative.meaning: ratingChange's negative flag: true means eloB should decrease and eloA should increase; false means eloA should decrease and eloB should increase
negative.checkpoint: before battleElo applies the rating update

better_party_rating_decreased.meaning: the party that performs better or wins sees their rating decrease after the update
better_party_rating_decreased.checkpoint: after battleElo applies change and negative

assumptions: battleElo calls Elo.ratingChange and applies the returned change and negative flag to update eloA and eloB after a single battle.
The better-performing party is the one whose rating should rise under the security intent.

unresolved.description: Report gives no numeric change values or concrete rating amounts, so the decrease/increase direction is represented only by grounded Boolean observables rather than an arithmetic relation.

limitations: Only the i_better_decrease impact is formalized; i_worse_increase and i_dependent_functions are handled in separate passes.
The condition encodes the negative=true branch of the intent; the negative=false branch is captured by the second precondition term but the relation obligation is stated for the true branch.
